runBootstrapSequence: KC-01 prove the canonical run alias and key-reference namespace are absent; otherwise KEY_REF_COLLISION
KC-03 obtain the run AEAD only through new AndroidKeystoreKmsClient.Builder().setKeyUri(alias).build().getAead(alias)
KC-04 encode the exact bounded plaintext and AAD and call Aead.encrypt(plaintext, aad)
KC-05 exclusive-create key-confirmation/run.kc.tmp with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_WRONLY|O_CLOEXEC; existing temp or final is never overwritten
KC-06 write the complete ciphertext to the temp descriptor
KC-07 fsync the temp file descriptor
KC-08 collision-check the final and rename key-confirmation/run.kc.tmp to key-confirmation/run.kc without overwrite
KC-09 fsync the key-confirmation parent directory
KC-10 write one SQLite run row containing exact relative name, byte length, SHA-256, canonical alias SHA-256 and confirmation state
KC-11 mark the non-exclusive SQLite transaction successful
KC-12 successful endTransaction() return is the durable semantic bootstrap commit
KC-13 only after KC-12 may the controller bootstrap event be emitted and any encrypted keyset, ciphertext, checkpoint or manifest publication begin

pathValidationRequired: canonical containment beneath the active run root
no symlink at any component or leaf
exclusive create and no-overwrite collision check

reconciliationAmendment.ALIAS_NO_CONFIRMATION_NO_DURABLE_ROW: INCOMPLETE_KEY_BOOTSTRAP; never replace or regenerate the alias; run is not execution-eligible; explicit retained/quarantine disposition required
reconciliationAmendment.KEY_CONFIRMATION_TEMP_ONLY: uncommitted temp; after path/type validation move through the quarantine transaction; never promote by name
reconciliationAmendment.KEY_CONFIRMATION_FINAL_NO_ROW: authenticated-orphan candidate; verify bytes and authentication fail closed, then move through the quarantine transaction; never infer commit
reconciliationAmendment.KEY_CONFIRMATION_ROW_MISSING_FINAL: KEY_CONFIRMATION_MISSING; split-brain; fail committed readiness and retain evidence
reconciliationAmendment.KEY_CONFIRMATION_ROW_LENGTH_HASH_OR_PARS: CORRUPT_KEY_CONFIRMATION; do not decrypt when structural identity fails
reconciliationAmendment.KEY_CONFIRMATION_AUTHENTICATION_MISMATCH: KEY_UNAVAILABLE_KEY_MISMATCH; never generate, replace or accept another alias
reconciliationAmendment.TEMP_AND_FINAL_COLLISION: KEY_REF_COLLISION for new bootstrap; never overwrite either object; quarantine only through the durable transaction
